title: SAFE-MEME: Structured Reasoning Framework for Robust Hate Speech Detection in Memes
findings: The study created new datasets (MHS and MHS-Con) for fine-grained hate speech detection, which include categories for religious groups like Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, and Christianity. Analysis of the dataset revealed that hate against Islam tends to be more explicit, while hate targeting the Jewish community is more often implicit. The error analysis showed that the proposed model (SAFE-MEME-QA) can be misled by keywords historically associated with religious or ethnic groups (e.g., 'Jew,' 'Nazi'), leading to incorrect classification and target identification.
